scripts.dev: set NODE_OPTIONS=--no-warnings&& concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: cd ./server &&  set NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation --no-warnings&& npm run watch
scripts.dev:client: cd ./client && set BROWSERSLIST_IGNORE_OLD_DATA=true&& npm run dev
scripts.build: concurrently "cd ./server && npm run watch" "cd ./client && npm run build"
scripts.install: cd ./server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
